Messages.Author: Pat Lusk
Messages.Body:
If you put the Eye of Hazimel on Beast or Wynn or another minion with a rush
special, does that minion get two cardless rushes per turn? (Assuming it
also possesses an appropriate untapping mechanism.)

Pat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


1) Beast cannot have the Eye or any other equipment.

2) Yes, where "cardless" means "via a distinct card in play".
